# Genesis Apocryphon Column 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words survive

---

**17:1** [...] the-generations [...] and-Shem fathered [...] Arpachshad [...]

**17:2** [...] and-Arpachshad fathered [...] Shelah [...] and-Shelah fathered Eber [...]

**17:3** [...] and-Eber fathered [...] Peleg [...] in-his-days the-earth was-divided [...]

**17:4** [...] Reu [...] Serug [...] Nahor [...]

**17:5** [...] and-Nahor fathered Terah [...] in-the-land of-Ur [...]

**17:6** [...] and-Terah fathered Abram [...] and-Nahor and-Haran [...]

**17:7** [...] Abram took-for-himself Sarai [...] as-a-wife [...]

**17:8** [...] and-Haran died [...] in-Ur of-the-Chaldeans [...] before Terah his-father [...]

**17:9** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 17 is nearly destroyed. The surviving fragments contain the genealogical transition from Shem to Abraham, paralleling Genesis 11:10-32. "Fathered" (yalad) follows project convention for male-subject genealogies. The genealogy traces the Shemite line through Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, and Terah to Abram. Construct chains preserved with hyphens.*
